scientific_integrity: The algebraic argument derives necessary and sufficient identities and rank strata for every truncation length. Related published characteristic-greater-than-two results are distinguished by hypotheses; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts exactly square-zero derivations of the one-variable truncated polynomial algebra in characteristic two; it makes no claim concerning all nilpotent derivations, orbit classification, or higher-dimensional polynomial quotients. Computations provide finite corroboration, not the general proof.
title: Rank spectra of square-zero derivations on truncated polynomial algebras in characteristic two
